about: Every place in supabase/functions that can write to Xero, and the X row (Integrated Job Framework A4 4.2, INT-33) it belongs to. xero_write_register_test.ts scans the sources and fails when a write site appears that no row names, or a row names one that is gone. Owner is the accountable desk, not the code. A new row, or a change to who passes a gate, is a person's decision (P2, P12): the CFO desk confirmed X1-X14 on 26 Oct (backend #1165, after its corrections) and Marnin approves the register. X15 records separately owner-authorised 28 Oct tracking corrections, with CFO confirmation pending and no extra deployment authority. changes_books: yes, no, draft_only (a Xero DRAFT posts nothing until a person approves it in Xero) or yes_when_authorised. sends_outside: the path can send to a customer or supplier. Human copy: docs/xero-write-register.md.

rows.write: Create a customer contact, or patch its address
rows.gate_today: Staff session (link_scope, create_invoice); the address sweep is a server job
Staff press; an agent send needs approval (Jarvis sw_send_quote)

rows.write: Create a customer invoice (deposit, acceptance, progress, final, per party)
rows.gate_today: Staff press; invariant Acceptance Deposit Invoice. createInvoice is the one creator: create_invoice, create_invoice_draft, create_deposit_invoice, complete_and_invoice and send_acceptance_invoice all reach it. The caller may ask for AUTHORISED (send_acceptance_invoice does by default), which posts and can email without X4's gate; over MCP the Claude client's permission prompt is the only human gate, by the owner's decision of 27 Oct 2026

rows.write: Approve, void or email a customer invoice
rows.gate_today: Jarvis durable Xero money gate: ACCREC needs confirm=true or a chat approval tap; ACCPAY needs confirm=true; unknown refuses. createInvoice's email runs only when its caller asks to send

rows.write: Record a payment against an invoice
rows.gate_today: Chat: Jarvis write tool (approval card). MCP: the Claude client's permission prompt only, by the owner's decision of 27 Oct 2026. Legacy SES guard. Marks the invoice paid in Xero, into the first active BANK account unless account_code is given, then lowers our copy's amount_due itself (verification V-07: amount_due, amount_paid and status come from its own arithmetic until the next sync)

rows.write: Push a crew bill (trade invoice), and attach its PDF
rows.gate_today: With the office-review switches off, a crew submit goes straight to a Xero DRAFT bill and the bookkeeper's approval in Xero is the check. With crew_invoice_line_office_review_v1 on, the invoice is held out of Xero
Expense approved (Shaun for a job, Jan for stock); push by admin, owner or ops_manager; DRAFT only

rows.write: Push or email a purchase order in Xero
rows.gate_today: Old path. Dispatch never pushes (slice 5 contract). Kept by choice only

rows.write: Draft, update or attach a supplier bill (ACCPAY), or draft a credit note
rows.gate_today: Forced to DRAFT (requireDraftStatus). Never authorised, voided or paid
One Xero DRAFT per variation, refused while customer_variation_xero_draft_v1 is off
rows.via: X3: create_customer_variation_xero_draft calls create_invoice_draft, which reaches createInvoice. It has no call site of its own

rows.write: Make-safe and SES invoices: authorise, void, update or delete a draft, authorise on send
rows.gate_today: Legacy SES guard; the SES pipeline's own gates (read-only to this framework)

rows.write: Edit a customer invoice, and email it after the edit
Find or create a trade's or supplier's Xero contact
Have Xero email a paid invoice to the customer as a receipt (fencing and patio)
rows.owner: Bookkeeping (new row found by INT-33; the CFO desk takes it)
rows.gate_today: job_closeout_settings.receipt_sender_mode (off, dry_run, live); server key only (job_receipt_paid, job_receipt_catch_up, posted by xero-sync); one claim per invoice. Contract docs/job-receipt-v1.md. receipt_sender_mode going to live is a send gate for Marnin

rows.write: Correct tracking on existing AUTHORISED or PAID supplier bills (ACCPAY)
rows.gate_today: Owner/admin JWT in the default organisation or dedicated server secret; POST only; preview is read-only; apply requires confirm=true, matching tenant and current snapshot hash, active tracking IDs, financial preservation and readback. Tracking only: no amount, tax, account, status or payment changes. Owner authorised implementation and bookkeeping corrections on 28 Oct 2026; this registration grants no deployment or broader live authority.

not_writes.why: The test-only export of ops-api's xeroPost transport. It forwards its caller's path and makes no call of its own
